description.zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~2852396~~)接口获取应用ID。
><notice>AppId 格式为 app- 前缀后接纯数字后缀，总长度 20 至 64 字符（示例：app-8806886***83794688）。可调用 ListEdgeContainerApps 获取已有 AppId，或先调用 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用。</notice>
description.en:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~2852396~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
><notice>The AppId is in the format of the app- prefix followed by a numeric suffix, with a total length of 20 to 64 characters (example: app-8806886***83794688). Call ListEdgeContainerApps to obtain an existing AppId, or call CreateEdgeContainerApp to create an application first.</notice>.
The log file of the container.

description.zh: 开启容器的标准输出采集。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable standard output collection for the container.

title.zh: 更新边缘容器日志采集配置信息
title.en: Update edge container log collection configuration

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-edge-container-app-log-river --app-id app-880688675783790000 --stdout true --path /root/hello.log --region cn-hangzhou
